args.body:
- Apparel return rates reached 24% in 2026, per Saltmarsh's retail returns logistics article (blog.saltmarsh.example/2026/returns).
- Consolidated return hubs cut handling costs by roughly a fifth (~20%).
- Per the companion piece (insights.saltmarsh.example/returns/companion), reselling returned items within 10 days preserved most of the margin.
args.title: Saltmarsh 2026 Returns — Combined Summary
